data.name: Jubion
data.gender_notes: Jubion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jubion is derived from the Hebrew word ‘yubal’ which means ‘to rejoice’ or ‘to exult’. It is also linked to the Greek word ‘jubaeo’ meaning ‘to shout’ or ‘to cry out’ in joy. In the Bible, the name Jubal is given to the father of all musicians, highlighting the joyful and musical nature of this name. The name Jubion carries the meaning “Rejoicing or Exulting” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jubion usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing or exulting and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name signifies the feeling of expansiveness and awe that comes from connecting with the Divine. It is a reminder to let our lives be filled with joy and to cry out in praise to the Creator, celebrating the gift of life and creation itself.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jubion may be derived from the Hebrew word "Yobel," meaning ram's horn or trumpet blast. In Christianity, it symbolizes the call to gather for joyous celebration and redemption, as in the year of Jubilee in the Old Testament.
